messages:
Maya Patel: Quick async sync — trying to close the EU4 region rollout tasks before EOD PST. Can owners ack the bullets below or flag blockers?

1) KMS key creation & cross-account grants for eu-west-4 (security/infra)
2) Data residency label + DPA signoff for EU4 (legal/compliance)
3) Smart-router policy to include eu4 model variants + canary weights (platform/runtime)
4) Autoscaler profile + capacity ticket for reserved GPU pool (sre/infra)
5) Telemetry & SLI thresholds for 99th p95 token latency in EU4 (observability)

Quick checks: 
- health endpoint should respond 200: `curl -I https://eu4.api.redwood.com/health`
- verify env var `REGION_LABEL=eu4` is present on gateway pods

Leah Ng: KMS — I created the CMK and added the draft grants, PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/445. Waiting on infra-ci to pass (failing on kms-perms test). ETA to merge ~2h if tests flip.

Ashok Rao: Legal — DPA addendum draft ready, sending to compliance for review now. One question: do we have any customers requiring EU-only key material? If so we need the HSM option enabled before we go live.

Diego Morales: Autoscale/capacity — I opened CAP-1279 to reserve 4x A100 slots for the Dedicated pool. Autoscaler tweak in ops-config PR: https://github.com/redwood/ops-config/pull/210 (increase maxBurst to 12 for eu4). Can we hold non-critical batch workloads during first 24h?

Priya Singh: Router/runtime — Added eu4 to smart-router mapping in staging, but need owners to confirm model alias fallbacks: `eu -> eu4` mapping is currently only for text-generation models. I'll open a tiny PR to add embeddings and reranking. Also we need to update the rollout policy to 5% canary for 6 hours: `canary: {region: eu4, weight: 5, window: 6h}`

sre-bot: jobs/ops-config/deploy #987 started by Diego Morales — status: queued -> running. Logs: `deploy:ops-config eu4 changes`

Maya Patel: Noted re HSM — @Ashok Rao can you confirm whether any enterprise contracts require HSM in region? If yes we delay go-live until HSM is provisioned (security).

Ashok Rao: Checking contract list now. I see two customers flagged as EU-only but neither explicitly requires HSM in the contract text. I will escalate to privacy for final sign-off, should have answer within 3h.

Leah Ng: infra-ci fixed — was a stale IAM role name. PR merged -> infra-ci green. KMS key usable now, I pushed kms:arn to secrets manager.

Priya Singh: Router PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/router/pull/999 — adds embeddings + rerank mapping and the 5% canary. Staging smoke passes.

Diego Morales: CAP-1279 provisioned 4 A100s, autoscaler PR merged. I set a temporary rule to deprioritize cron batch jobs for 24h.

Maya Patel: Great — blockers minimized. Action items:
- @Ashok Rao finish legal sign-off (target +3h)
- @Leah Ng confirm secrets propagation to production (once infra CI + deploy done)
- @Priya Singh monitor canary for 6h and post anomalies here
- @Diego Morales keep capacity reserved and notify if bursting > 8 GPUs

If no objections I’ll mark the rollout as ‘soft-live’ tonight and update the rollout board. :thumbsup:

Ashok Rao: Will update here when legal sign-off done.

Leah Ng: Secrets propagated to prod in eu4, verified `REGION_LABEL` on gateway pods and health check returns 200.

Priya Singh: Canary at 5% live in eu4, first 30min: p95 token latency looks within expected range (+3% vs eu-west-1). Will ping if we exceed 10% regression.

sre-bot: alert: infra-autoscaler eu4 scale-up triggered at 1749008120 — scaled +2 nodes.

Maya Patel: Thanks team — I’ll close the ticket if Ashok confirms legal. Otherwise we hold. Follow-up sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC to review first-day metrics. Link to runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INF/EU4+rollout+runbook
